<ic>Announcement of the Quartermaster’s Guerdon:<br> The Black Thorns <br> The Bounders <br> The Freeborn Storm <br> The Seventh Wave <br> The Wolves of War <br> The Golden Sun <br> The Eastern Sky <br> Are entitled to draw from the Imperial Guerdon following the Summer Solstice 381YE.
<br><br>
<i>Approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was approved by the Quartermaster General of the Imperial Armies using the legal power to authorise targets of the Imperial Guerdon granted to them by the Senate

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* Owners of military units who support one of the announced armies will receive a share of the Imperial Guerdon.
